text:
pagerduty-bot: URGENT: Paging primary oncall for auth-service — sudden spike in token-validate 401s and unusual egress patterns detected for idp-auth-prod. Pager: oncall-alice.

oncall-alice: I'm on it, looking now. ETA 2m.

oncall-alice: Quick metric snapshot — token-validate 401 rate jumped from ~0.6% -> ~14% over last 6m, overall 5xx steady. Grafana: https://grafana.company/re/dash/abcd/auth-service?from=-10m

ben-eng: I see a bunch of outbound requests to an external S3 bucket from a staging task earlier, and a few log lines that look like partial auth headers. sample: ```
[2026-03-17T02:45:12Z] svc-auth svc=token-validate user_id=... token=eyJhbGci... partial_key=AKIA... dest=s3://external-bucket/path.log
```

carmen-sec: if logs mention keys we have potential PII/credential exposure. Start containment: block the suspicious egress IP ranges, limit token validation rate, and prepare key rotation plan. I'll open an incident channel with legal.

oncall-alice: running quick search across prod logs (short):
```bash
curl -s "https://logs.search/internal/_search?q=token%3DeyJhbGci*&size=5" | jq '.hits.hits[]._source | {time,svc,dest,client_id}'
```
results show ~12 unique client_id values, 2 customers showing elevated 401 tickets.

sre-bot: executed containment playbook step: added WAF rule block for outgoing IP 34.120.55.23 and throttled /token-validate route to 50r/s per client. Change-ID: waf-4921, rollout: canary->prod.

product-ops: support has two customers reporting 401s (acct: acme-inc, acct: teachly). They report auth failures but no reports of data download. We're drafting a notification template.

ben-eng: preparing targeted token revocation for suspected compromised client_ids. Running revoke script against auth-db (rolling, nonblocking):
```bash
python tools/revoke_tokens.py --client-ids file://suspect_clients.txt --dry-run=false --parallel=4
```
will coordinate with KMS for key rotation.

carmen-sec: priority: rotate any IAM keys referenced in logs, rotate service keys for svc-auth in staging immediately. Prod rotation plan: initiate key rotation + short-lived tokens rollout within 2h, contingent on smoke results. I'll open KMS ticket and ping infra.

oncall-alice: current status: WAF and throttling in place, revoke in progress (30% done), 401 rate down to ~3% from peak. No confirmed data exfil reports yet.

legal: Please loop me in if there's confirmed log leakage that contains customer PII or long-lived credentials. We may need to notify impacted customers per policy.

oncall-alice: handing off active work to ben-eng for the next 2h — passing context: spike detected -> WAF block -> partial token revocation -> KMS rotation queued. Customers notified: preliminary message drafted (product-ops). Ben, you're primary.

ben-eng: ack, taking over. I'll post hourly updates and escalate to full sec-scrub if we see any downloads from exposed URIs. tagging @carmen-sec for KMS ops.

product-ops: sending out initial customer advisory to acme-inc and teachly (template: "We're investigating elevated auth failures; mitigations in flight; no confirmed data access; will update in 1h").

carmen-sec: opening KMS rotation ticket now (KMS-TKT-8192), ETA for staging rotation 30m, prod rotation ~2h after final smoke.

oncall-alice: leaving channel, monitoring handoff completed. If anything regresses, page me immediately. :white_check_mark:

ben-eng: update 1769460500 — revoke completed for listed client_ids, WAF still active, 401s stable ~2.8%. Continuing key rotation verification.
